name.zh: Eocladus 保存型复枝藻轴片段

description.en: Use distinct thickness steps between branch orders and a flattened specimen layout; simplify terminal count only.
description.zh: 在分枝级间使用明确粗细阶差，并采用扁平标本布局；仅简化末枝数量。

sources.title: Complex noncalcified macroalgae from the Silurian of Cornwallis Island
sources.supports: Eocladus complex branching orders and Silurian occurrence.
sources.access_origin: inherited inventory research; not reopened by this planner
sources.rights_note: Consultation is not a license to redistribute source media.

reconstruction_notes.en: Fossil-specimen only: original flattened narrow axis segment carrying coarse-to-fine branched laterals through several orders. Limited teaching thickness, nominal0.16m span, muted gray-green fossil palette and simplified terminal counts are art choices. Primary genus description consulted for basic architecture; original inventory needs-specific-reference status retained. No named figure/specimen replica, unknown complete thallus, high extra stalk, holdfast, roots, reproductive bodies or out-of-plane growth asserted. Cylindrical segment character is expressed with softened limited relief.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 仅化石标本：原创扁平窄轴片段，侧枝以粗细阶差表达数级分枝。有限教学厚度、0.16米名义跨度、柔和灰绿化石色及末枝数量简化为美术设定。已查阅属级原始描述支持基本枝序；保留原始needs-specific-reference状态。不宣称具名图/标本复制，不添加未知完整藻体、额外高茎、固着器、根、生殖体或离面生长。圆柱形分枝节段用柔和有限浮雕厚度表达。

scientific_scope.en: Independently reviewed original stylized-inspired static teaching art. Palette, pose, nominal dimensions and simplified anatomy are artistic choices; not a strict scientific reconstruction or coexistence claim.
scientific_scope.zh: 通过独立审查的原创静态风格化启发教学美术；配色、姿态、名义尺寸及简化解剖属于美术选择，不作严格科学复原或同域共存主张。
